name: MyAi token business-logic flaw
summary: The MyAi contract's reward/transfer accounting can be driven to credit the caller without a matching deposit, so the attacker extracted the paired WBNB from the pool.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
